limits: Local demo identities and simulated suppliers, not external business authentication.
Kiln extracts candidate semantics; quote inclusion does not prove semantic interpretation. Bilateral signatures confirm the normalized Deal.
Pinned repository reference values validate delivery; this run is not an independent unseen-PDF benchmark.
No A2A/AP2/ERC-8183 compatibility claim. Signed internal-orchestrator capture envelope only.
No hidden chain-of-thought stored. Only outward message content and extraction tool arguments.
Local test asset transactions; previous Sepolia evidence belongs to the escrow backend, not a new DealTrace public run.
NPU hardware energy and AI superiority are not measured.
